verdict.rationale:
pnpm docs show real supply-chain controls: `pnpm audit` verifies ECDSA registry signatures against published keys, lockfile integrity/checksum mismatches block installs unless explicitly overridden with the narrow `--update-checksums` flag, and install scripts require explicit approval before running. However, signature/audit checks are a separate opt-in command rather than automatic gating before every install, and there's no mention of package attestations (e.g. SLSA/provenance) or automatic pre-execution verification of signatures.

missing for 10: attestation/provenance verification, automatic (non-opt-in) signature checking before every install/run, independent confirmation these checks catch real-world tampering.
